description:
We love a good custom build. This is a frame only option. We offer full custom builds as well, please email sales@tout-terrain.bike for a full custom quote.
Fun, adventurous, and ready to be ridden far, the Outback Xplore II 29 is any bikepacker or off-road explorer’s best friend. Already a well-known ally for two-wheeled travel, the latest Outback is even more capable than its predecessor, with wider tire clearance—for up to 2.6” tires—additional mounting bosses on the top and down tubes, and our tried and tested Pinion-specific steel frame for reliable, maintenance-free shifting in any conditions. Pick between a rigid carbon or soft suspension fork. With Outback, every ride will be an adventure.
